items.name: Malta End of Summer 2025

venue.name: [The University of Malta](https://www.um.edu.mt/)
venue.details: KSU-PWC Common Room, Student’s House, University of Malta MSD2080

items.information:
Welcome to the third official WCA competition in Malta!
Please check all tabs, especially [if you are a new competitor](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MaltaEndofSummer2025#55260-for-new-competitors).
Please also check the [competition schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MaltaEndofSummer2025#competition-schedule) in the dedicated tab, as the competition will start in the early morning with some advanced events, be interrupted for a few hours by [FMC Europe 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MaltaEndofSummer2025#63651-fmc-europe-2025) and continue in the afternoon with the most popular events.

items.name: Malta Open 2024

venue.name: [The University of Malta](https://www.um.edu.mt/)
venue.address: Mathematics and Physics Building, University of Malta, Msida MSD 2080, Malta.

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzY3NTIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--345fb6f71661c618d769cbb8e8ab588aae97b650/Logo%20Malta%20Open%202024%202.png)

This is the second WCA competition in Malta. It is an open competition for all people from all ages and all countries.
We hope many people from Malta and other countries will participate.

The competition also counts as the national championship for Malta: the best competitors from Malta will be the national champions 2024 of Malta.
